newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-MARK WAUGH CAPTURES 6-68 IN DRAWN TOUR OPENER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-MARK WAUGH CAPTURES 6-68 IN DRAWN TOUR OPENER.

text.p: Mark Waugh snapped up six for 68 with his off-breaks on a slow-turning pitch as Australia drew the opening match of their tour of India on Monday.
Waugh sent the Indian Board President's XI sliding from 153 for two to 262 all out -- 96 behind on first innings.
Australia then batted out the third and final day at 99 for two, drawing a match in which the first two sessions on the opening day were washed out by rain.
Pankaj Dharmani, a wicketkeeper for Punjab in domestic cricket, made a stroke-filled, unbeaten 130 off 170 balls in 231 minutes after the Board President's XI resumed at the overnight 85 for two.
Waugh started the day with a return catch to dismiss left-hander Vangipurappu Laxman, named at the weekend in India's squad for the one-off test against Australia starting in New Delhi on Thursday.

All of Waugh's other victims fell in his second spell. But he could not make an impression on Dharmani, who straight drove him for an elegant six in his century that also included 22 fours, many of them fine strokes on the offside.
